afterSign.text: The hill works. Now a second hill, to admire the first one from.
afterSign.subject: kites

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT BUILDS HILL TO LOOK AT HILL
clippings.refuse: KITES ADMIRE HILL FROM THE CHAIR

afterRefuse.text: Then lend the League the Committee's stepladder. Sundays. Mostly Sundays.
afterRefuse.subject: kites

clippings.sign: HEDGES GO UNTRIMMED ON SUNDAYS, AND MOST TUESDAYS
clippings.refuse: LEAGUE LAUNCHES FROM CHAIR, WITH DIGNITY

afterSign.text: The hedge of you must now match each new haircut. Weekly, I suggest.
afterSign.subject: vanity

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT'S HEDGE HAS BETTER HAIRCUT THAN PRESIDENT
clippings.refuse: HEDGE OF PRESIDENT GROWS OUT; LIKENESS FADES

afterRefuse.text: Your hedge entered the show alone. Come and watch it come second.
afterRefuse.subject: hedges

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT APPLAUDS OWN HEDGE; HEDGE BOWS
clippings.refuse: HEDGE OF PRESIDENT COLLECTS SECOND PRIZE ALONE

afterSign.text: The maze is 99 % free of kites. Fund a search for the rest?
afterSign.subject: kites

clippings.sign: SEARCH PARTY FINDS KITE; SEARCH PARTY NOW LOST
clippings.refuse: LOST KITE GIVEN POSTAL ADDRESS; STAYS LOST

afterRefuse.text: Then a study of the strings in the maze. It meets at the centre, once found.
afterRefuse.subject: hedges

clippings.sign: STRING STUDY GOES IN AT NOON; NOT YET OUT
clippings.refuse: KITE STRINGS STAY IN THE HEDGES, UNCOUNTED

afterSign.text: The band would like to hire one breeze back. For its flags.
afterSign.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT SELLS SAME WIND TWICE; WIND UNAWARE
clippings.refuse: BAND'S FLAGS HANG STILL; CONCERT CALLED 'RESPECTFUL'

afterRefuse.text: Then fund a study of the breeze over Brassby. By kite, of course.
afterRefuse.subject: kites

clippings.sign: WIND STUDY FLIES ALL AFTERNOON; NO FINDINGS LAND
clippings.refuse: WIND OVER BRASSBY STAYS UNMEASURED, AND UNHIRED

afterSign.text: Your first kite is still up, in a hedge. List it as a landmark?
afterSign.subject: kites

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT'S KITE LISTED; HEDGE LISTED WITH IT
clippings.refuse: PRESIDENT'S KITE COMES DOWN ON ITS OWN, AT LAST

afterRefuse.text: No first kite, so no second. The League waits. Let go now?
afterRefuse.subject: kites

clippings.sign: SEASON OPENS LATE; PRESIDENT LETS GO EARLY
clippings.refuse: KITE SEASON STILL WAITING TO START

afterSign.text: The hedge clock says spring. The calendar does not. An inquiry?
afterSign.subject: clocks

clippings.sign: INQUIRY BACKS HEDGE; CALENDAR TO BE TRIMMED
clippings.refuse: HEDGE AND CALENDAR NO LONGER SPEAKING

afterRefuse.text: No clock, then. Stand by the hedge at noon and point up? Once.
afterRefuse.subject: clocks

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT STANDS IN FOR CLOCK; RUNS AN HOUR SLOW
clippings.refuse: HEDGE STILL DOES NOT TELL THE TIME. NEVER DID

afterSign.text: The step we now sit on is 60 % sea. The top step, please.
afterSign.subject: harbours

clippings.sign: BAND MOVES DOWN TO BOTTOM STEP; TUBA GETS WET
clippings.refuse: ANGLERS STAY ON WET STEP. 'QUIETER,' SAYS ONE

afterRefuse.text: Not on the steps, then. Beside them, from a boat. Fund the boat?
afterRefuse.subject: harbours

clippings.sign: BAND PLAYS FROM BOAT; BOAT DRIFTS TOWARDS ANGLERS
clippings.refuse: BAND PLAYS ON QUAY, WAVING AT A BOAT IT LACKS

afterSign.text: A sign for the dim lighthouse: PRESIDENT AT WORK. Lit all night.
afterSign.subject: vanity

clippings.sign: LIGHTHOUSE SAYS PRESIDENT AT WORK; FISH AWAKE TO CHECK
clippings.refuse: FISH SLEEP ON; PRESIDENT'S WORK GOES UNLIT

afterRefuse.text: Then come and say 'hush' to the lighthouse. It may listen to you.
afterRefuse.subject: harbours

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT SHUSHES LIGHTHOUSE; LIGHTHOUSE CARRIES ON
clippings.refuse: LIGHTHOUSE NOT SHUSHED. ANGLERS SHUSH EACH OTHER

afterSign.text: Log one coach from the bench. We will tell you which are coaches.
afterSign.subject: buses

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT LOGS VAN AS COACH; SOCIETY POLITE
clippings.refuse: BENCH LOGS COACHES ALL DAY WITHOUT PRESIDENT

afterRefuse.text: No bench, then. May we lean on the hedge? We have a rota.
afterRefuse.subject: buses

clippings.sign: HEDGE LEANED ON IN SHIFTS; HEDGE NOW LEANS TOO
clippings.refuse: SPOTTERS STAND UNAIDED, LOGGING BRAVELY

afterSign.text: Under the tea lamps, 94 % of coaches are logged 'beige'. One plain lamp?
afterSign.subject: buses

clippings.sign: ONE PLAIN LAMP LIT; TILL'S TEAS CALLS IT 'WEAK'
clippings.refuse: COACH OF THE YEAR: 'BEIGE', AGAIN

afterRefuse.text: Then Till's Teas will hire just the bus stop lamp. It would say TEA.
afterRefuse.subject: signage

clippings.sign: BUS STOP NOW SAYS TEA; NO TEA ARRIVES
clippings.refuse: LAMP BY BUS STOP CONTINUES TO SAY NOTHING

afterSign.text: The pumpkin tours again. It asks for the spotters' front seat. Then yours.
afterSign.subject: vegetable-shows

clippings.sign: PUMPKIN TAKES FRONT SEAT; PRESIDENT IN ROW TWO
clippings.refuse: SPOTTERS KEEP FRONT SEAT; PUMPKIN TOURS IN THE BOOT

afterRefuse.text: The pumpkin toured without you. It kept your seat. Ride the last stop?
afterRefuse.subject: vegetable-shows

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT RIDES LAST STOP; PUMPKIN WAVES FIRST
clippings.refuse: EMPTY SEAT TOURS NINE PROVINCES; WELL RECEIVED

afterSign.text: Your lawn came third of three. Edge it yourself for the rematch?
afterSign.subject: gardens

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT RE-EDGES OWN LAWN. STILL THIRD
clippings.refuse: LAWN UNEDGED; THIRD PLACE KEPT

afterRefuse.text: Then a study of your lawn edges. From the kite field, then from a kite.
afterRefuse.subject: gardens

clippings.sign: LAWN STUDY GOES UP BY KITE; EDGES 'STRAIGHTER FROM ABOVE'
clippings.refuse: LAWN EDGES STAY UNSTUDIED, AND UNEVEN
